name: Troika Three Text
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: SDF text meshes for Three.js with font loading and Web Worker typesetting
summary: Text rendering for Three.js: a Text mesh that typesets TTF, OTF or WOFF fonts in a worker and renders them with signed-distance fields, giving crisp text at any size with outline, stroke, curve and per-range colouring. Driven from JavaScript by setting properties and calling sync(); output is a Three.js mesh. This is the text layer that drei's Text wraps.
use_when: Crisp, animatable text inside a Three.js or R3F scene
Over canvas-texture text when size varies or the camera moves close
Dynamic text with arbitrary fonts and no pre-built atlas
avoid_when: Extruded 3D letterforms: Three.js TextGeometry with a typeface JSON
HTML titles over video: GSAP on DOM text is simpler and sharper

assessment.rationale: Release 0.52.5 on 2026-07-24; the standard SDF text for Three.js and the engine behind drei's Text. Adds runtime font typesetting that catalogued msdfgen (offline atlases) and opentype-js (outlines) do not give directly.

notes: 2026-10-26: sync() is async, so capture must wait for it; not tested. official_url is a monorepo subpath.
